samples.summary: `seg()` rejects the empty string, but `resolveConfig` legitimately yields `workspace: ''` — so every command (and every `--dry-run` preview) now fails with a misleading `Invalid identifier ""` for an unconfigured caller
samples.evidence: `resolveConfig` returns `workspace: ''` on all four resolution paths when no `--workspace`, `WAFFLEBASE_WORKSPACE`, session `activeWorkspace` or profile value exists (packages/cli/src/config/config.ts:100, :125, :147, :163), and `packages/cli/test/config.test.ts:30` asserts exactly that default. `packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:106` also persists `activeWorkspace = ''` when the account has zero workspaces, and the comment at config.ts:108 records the empty-workspace state as a known, reachable outcome ("turning every command into a `/workspaces//...` 404"). After this change `apiV1Base()`/`apiKeysUrl()` call `seg(config.workspace)` (packages/cli/src/client/url.ts:50, :62), which throws `Invalid identifier "": a URL path segment cannot be empty, "." or ".."` for that state. Two out-of-diff consequences: (a) every workspace-scoped command for an unconfigured user now reports `{"error":{"code":"ERROR","message":"Invalid identifier \"\"..."}}` instead of the previous auth/404 error, with nothing pointing at the missing workspace config — agents branching on the documented codes in docs/design/cli.md §9 get an undocumented `ERROR`; (b) `--dry-run` previews, which previously succeeded with no config at all (they only formatted a URL), now fail. The fix belongs on the new code: distinguish "workspace not configured" (a clear WORKSPACE_REQUIRED-style error) from "identifier is a dot segment".

samples.summary: New dry-run branches sit outside the action's try/catch, so a `seg()` throw bypasses command-level `outputError` and escapes to `runCli`'s last-resort envelope — inconsistent with the sibling namespaces
samples.evidence: `docs get` previews at packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:126-129, `sheets tabs list` at packages/cli/src/commands/tabs.ts:15-18 and `sheets cells get` at packages/cli/src/commands/cells.ts:21-33 are all placed before the `try {`. `printDryRun` can now throw (via `seg()` on the identifier or the workspace, packages/cli/src/client/url.ts:34), whereas before the change it could not, so the throw leaves the action entirely instead of being enveloped by the command's own `catch (e) { outputError(e) }` — only `runCli`'s catch (packages/cli/src/cli.ts:90) sees it. The equivalent previews in notes.ts:84, slides.ts:89, files.ts:115 and api-keys.ts:70-74 are inside the try, so the same user error is handled two different ways; packages/cli/test/read-dry-run.test.ts:305 vs :316 codifies the divergence (envelope for `api-keys revoke ..`, raw rejection for `docs get ..`). Pre-existing dry-run branches at docs.ts:145/:163, tabs.ts:49/:73, files.ts:132/:150, notes.ts:101/:119, slides.ts:106/:124 are affected the same way now that `printDryRun` can throw.

samples.summary: Adding `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push` / `GITHUB_REF_NAME=main` to the empty-string fail-safe test makes that guard vacuous: `resolve()` returns on the push-to-main branch before the empty-string path is distinguishable
samples.evidence: `resolve()` short-circuits on `if (env.WAFFLEBASE_CHANGED_AREAS)` (scripts/changed-areas.mjs:510) — an empty string is falsy, so control falls to the push-to-main gate at scripts/changed-areas.mjs:530-534, which returns `FULL("push to main — ...")` unconditionally. With the new env the assertions at scripts/test/changed-areas.test.mjs:729-730 would pass even if the empty-string handling were deleted, and they duplicate the existing "push to main is never filtered" test at scripts/test/changed-areas.test.mjs:223-225. The guard this test was written for (an empty `WAFFLEBASE_CHANGED_AREAS` must not select zero lanes) is no longer covered by anything; a repo-independent alternative would be a non-main event with a stubbed/unresolvable diff base, or asserting the reason does NOT mention the areas variable.

samples.summary: `HttpClient`'s id-taking methods now throw synchronously instead of returning a rejected promise, changing the contract the injected-client interfaces imply
samples.evidence: `getDocument` (packages/cli/src/client/http-client.ts:202), `deleteDocument` (:208), `getCell` (:352) etc. are non-async methods whose bodies evaluate `seg(id)` before calling `this.request`, so an invalid identifier throws synchronously rather than rejecting the returned promise. The stub-facing interfaces those methods satisfy (`FilesUploadClient` in packages/cli/src/files/upload.ts, `DocsImportClient` in packages/cli/src/docs/import.ts:10, `NotesImportClient` in packages/cli/src/notes/import.ts:8) declare `Promise`-returning members, so any consumer that stores the call without an immediate `await` inside a try (`Promise.all`, `.catch(...)`) would now get an uncaught throw. I grepped packages/cli/src for `Promise.all`, `.then(` and `).catch(` and found no such consumer today, so this is a latent contract hazard rather than a current break; marking the methods `async` (or validating inside `request()`) would close it.
searchedFor: all getClient(...) call sites in packages/cli/src/commands

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo: seg() throws on the empty string (packages/cli/src/client/url.ts:31-41), and both apiV1Base (url.ts:50) and apiKeysUrl (url.ts:61) pass config.workspace through it. resolveConfig legitimately returns workspace: '' on all four branches (config.ts:96-100, :121-126, :143-147, :160-164), a default asserted by test/config.test.ts:30 and described as a reachable state by the comments at config.ts:105-110 and test/config.test.ts:99-103; login.ts:106-108 persists activeWorkspace = '' for a zero-workspace account. No guard rejects or defaults an empty workspace anywhere before URL construction: root.ts:29-40 (getConfig/getClient) validates nothing, HttpClient's base getter calls apiV1Base unconditionally (http-client.ts:86-88), apiKeysUrl is reached from http-client.ts:386/392/402 and api-keys.ts:16, and dry-run.ts:18 builds previews via apiV1Base. So an unconfigured user's every workspace-scoped command, and every --dry-run preview (which previously required no config at all and only formatted a URL), now throws 'Invalid identifier ""' instead of the prior auth/404 path. This is an out-of-diff contract break — a new precondition on an exported symbol that existing producers and consumers do not satisfy — squarely in the blast-radius lane, and major under its rubric (callers left broken/inconsistent by a changed contract). Nothing supports not-present, already-guarded, or out-of-scope.

finding.summary: New empty-segment rejection in `seg()` fires on the *unconfigured workspace* path that `resolveConfig` deliberately produces, breaking every command — including offline `--dry-run` previews
finding.evidence: `resolveConfig` returns `workspace: ''` whenever no `--workspace`, `WAFFLEBASE_WORKSPACE`, session `activeWorkspace` or profile workspace is present — packages/cli/src/config/config.ts:100, :126, :147 and :163 (step 4 is even commented "Nothing available … commands will fail"). Every consumer now routes through `apiV1Base()` → `seg('')`, which throws. Two out-of-diff consequences: (a) the live path that previously produced `/api/v1/workspaces//documents` and a server 404 envelope (documented at packages/cli/src/config/config.ts:108 and packages/cli/test/config.test.ts:102) now dies with `Invalid identifier "": a URL path segment cannot be empty…`, which tells a user nothing about logging in or setting `--workspace`; (b) `printDryRun` (packages/cli/src/client/dry-run.ts:19) also goes through `apiV1Base`, so `wafflebase docs get d1 --dry-run` — a purely offline preview that every skill doc tells agents to run first (packages/cli/skills/docs-manage.md:59) — now throws instead of printing a preview when the user has not logged in yet. No call site supplies a fallback workspace.

verdict.reason: The described code exists and is reachable. `seg()` rejects the empty string (packages/cli/src/client/url.ts:31-41) and is applied to `config.workspace` in both URL builders (url.ts:50, url.ts:61). `resolveConfig` deliberately yields `workspace: ''` in all four resolution branches (config/config.ts:100, :126, :147, :164 — step 4 is even labelled "Nothing available"), and neither `resolveConfig` nor `getConfig` (commands/root.ts:29-36) rejects it. Every live request routes through `apiV1Base` via `HttpClient.base` (client/http-client.ts:86-88) and every offline preview through the same builder (client/dry-run.ts:18), so with no login and no `--workspace` even a pure `--dry-run` preview throws instead of printing. I searched for a pre-flight guard and found none: only informational "Not logged in" messages in commands that never build a v1 URL (commands/ctx.ts:47,61; commands/status.ts:11) and a post-response SESSION_EXPIRED envelope (http-client.ts:160-167). The prior contract (empty segment → `/api/v1/workspaces//documents` → server 404) is documented in config.ts:108 and asserted-about in test/config.test.ts:99-103, confirming this is a behaviour change for out-of-diff consumers rather than a pre-existing rejection. That is a new precondition on an exported builder with unupdated call sites — in-lane for blast radius, major impact. Only nit: skills/docs-manage.md:59 shows `docs create --dry-run`, not `docs get`, but the doc does recommend dry-run first (:56, :87), so the substance stands.
